notes: ✨ Refine on every note box of the software (notes, remarks, messages) and in every email editor and email template (formatting and {Fields} are kept). Same writing everywhere, as you type: names, company, contact person, city, state … in CAPITALS; email in small letters; mobile numbers digits only with the set number of digits (red warning if wrong); pincode 6 digits, Aadhaar 12; GSTIN, PAN, IFSC in capitals with a format check. The main PC also saves names, cities, IFSC, Udyam no. this way. Company settings, email templates and analysis reports keep the writing as typed.
